title: Nanxuan Li
text: Hi, I’m Nanxuan Li. I am from Toronto and completed my undergraduate studies in Statistics and Economics at the University of Toronto. Before joining the MDS program, I developed an interest in using data to understand and solve real-world problems. Through the MDS program, I hope to improve my data analysis and programming skills.

title: About
text: I completed my undergraduate studies at the University of Toronto, where I majored in Statistics and Economics. My studies gave me experience working with data and helped me develop an interest in applying statistical methods to real-world problems.

Why Data Science
I chose to study data science because I want to strengthen my programming and analytical skills. During the MDS program, I hope to gain more experience with tools such as Python, R, SQL, and data visualization, and learn how to use them effectively in practical projects.

Outside Data Science
Outside of data science, I enjoy skiing and sport shooting. I especially enjoy skiing during the winter and spending time outdoors. I also like exploring new technology and learning new skills in my free time.
